Support: - Galvanized steel, painted or not, Painted aluminum alloy,

For a circuit-breaker equipped with a "dial-type" SF6 gas densimeter, make 
 sure that the intersection of the needle and the temperature circle is in the 
 green zone.

If the intersection is in either the yellow or red zone, for the same 
 disposition as above, without any particular indication from the electrical 
 contact densimeter, verify the concordance of different information sources to 
 find the defective element and then replace it.

Replacement of a dial densimeter is described in the section "REPLACEMENT OF 
ELEMENTS OR SUB-ASSEMBLIES"

If observation confirms the information "topping up" (yellow zone) perform a 
topping up operation in accordance with "SF6 GAS TOPPING UP", or in the case of 
abnormally low voluminal mass (red zone) find the origin of the leak and repair 
it.

Clean air vents, 
 free of dust, and unobstructed. If necessary, clean using a solvent.

(recommended thermostat temperature: + 5 
oC.

CAUTION: This type of intervention should always be performed with 
the circuit-breaker de-pressurized. before acting, bring the hydraulic circuit pressure to zero 
procedure described in section "pre-commissioning inspections and testes"

Check for substantial leak (drip after drip) if detected during a 
maintenance visit, a repair operation should be programmed as quickly as possible 
in accordance with the lock-out possibilities of the apparatus. The following 
operations must be performed with the apparatus out of service, mechanically and 
electrically isolated and earthed:

Bring the 
 hydraulic circuit to zero pressure,

Remove the 
 faulty union,
Clean the parts,

Re-install union 
 with a new seal

Check for internal leak due to a number of pump starts above the permissible average (4 per 
 24 hours). Do not count starts following circuit-operations. Quickly get in 
 touch with GEC ALS-THOM T&D S.A. Aftersales Service

Check that the receiver oil 
 level should always be between the limits given by the column level indicator. 
 If oil lacks, top up using hydraulic oil complying with regulations AIR 3520/B 
 or USA-MIL 05606.

Read indications 
 given by the counter(s) and note these on the inspection card "maintenance 
 visits". The number of circuit-breaker operations recorded influences future 
 maintenance operations.

Read pump-start 
 counter indications and note these on the service card "maintenance visits"

If the average number of pump-starts between 2 maintenance visits is higher than 
4 per 24 hours, do not count starting after circuit breaker operations- with no 
other signal but "pressure decrease", an internal leak exists in the hydraulic 
system. Quickly get in touch with GEC ALS-THOM T&D S.A. After sales Service
Check the electrical contact SF6 densimeter thresholds,
If the values found are outside required tolerances replace the densimeter,

Check fixations tightening of elements not pressurized (frame, 
 cubicle, ...),

Check and adjust, with a torque wrench, the tightening torques 
 of screws on sub-assemblies not subjected to oil or gas pressure. The 
 tightening torques are given in paragraph
 of screw tightening torques (figure 6).
Check the pre-inflation pressure of accumulators
If an accumulator does not show the correct pre-inflation pressure, replace it
Check the switching thresholds of each oil pressure switch contact,
If values are outside required tolerances replace the oil pressure switch,

Closing lock-out, Automatic opening, 
 Anti-pumping,
Oil pressure decrease, SF6 pressure decrease

With the electric cubicle out of service, check that the clips 
 and tips of conductors are tightened correctly and check the torque of 
 connection mountings.

Remove the 
 re-inflation until (70.00) cover (73.00)

Disconnect the 
 electric feeding connector from the re-inflation unit

Uncouple HP and 
 LP pipes at their arrival on the re-inflation unit

Remove mounting 
 screws of the hydraulic component supporting plate on the re-inflation unit

Put the lifting 
 rings in place

Slowly lift the 
 hydraulic component supporting plate

Wait for a few 
 minutes, allowing the oil to drain off,

Remove the 
 filter cartridge mounting nut (72.41).

Remove the 
 filter cartridge (72.40) and seal.

Install a new 
 filter cartridge and seal.

Re-tighten using 
 the nut.

Re-install and 
 attach supporting plate, piping connectors and cover.

Connectors and 
 cover. Before resumption of service bleed hydraulic circuits,

Check the 
 condition of insulating envelopes, these should be free from impact marks, 
 splintering cracks, dust deposits, pollution etc ...
If this the case, clean with a dry rag.

If anomalies are found contact : GEC ALSTHOM T&D S.A. After sales Service in 
order to change the defective parts

Measure the 
 operating times of poles and auxiliary contacts at rated voltage and pressure.

If the values 
 found are outside the acceptable contact GEC ALSTHOM T&D S.A. After sales Service.
Measure the main circuit's resistance
If the values found are outside the acceptable, contact GEC ALSTHOM T&D S.A. After sales Service.

Change the 
 operating oil: completely bleed the hydraulic circuits by bringing the 
 pressure down to zero, collecting oil in the re-inflation unit receiver.

Bleed the 
 receiver using the checking block motor-pump unit whose vinyl pipe is placed 
 in a recipient large enough to hold all the oil from the hydraulic circuit Or by sucking 
 the oil from the receiver through its filling hole using a stand-by pump which 
 empties it into a recipient large enough to hold all the oil from the 
 hydraulic circuit,

Fill the 
 hydraulic circuit's L.P. receiver with fresh hydraulic oil complying with 
 regulations AIR 3520/B or USA-MIL 05606. Energize and pressurize electric and 
 hydraulic circuits respectively.

Bleed all the 
 hydraulic circuits for this operation consult section hydraulic circuits 
 filling and bleeding.
